'''Zaryos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived at the [[Jedi Colony]] established on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

==Biography==
During the [[Invasion of Ossus]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] the colony was due to be evacuated, but Zaryos explained to [[Nadia Grell]], [[Tau Idair]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] that they could not leave until they had downloaded their data to his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[D9-S2]], emphasizing that they found out how to grow crops in a radioactive wasteland, and that such information would be invaluable to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Idair assured Zaryos that they had it covered, and that he should get to the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] so everyone could get loaded up faster. When the Commander also insisted upon it, Zaryos relented and left the data in the hands of Idair, Nadia, and the Commander, just as [[Imperial soldier]]s arrived.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Mounting a Defense|Ossus}}</ref>
